```{r}
#imputation??
# Function to calculate mode
get_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

# Copy your dataset (so you don't overwrite original)
imputed_df <- clean_df

# Loop through each column
for (col in names(imputed_df)) {
  
  # If numeric --> mean imputation
  if (is.numeric(imputed_df[[col]])) {
    mean_val <- mean(imputed_df[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    imputed_df[[col]][is.na(imputed_df[[col]])] <- mean_val
  }
  
  # If factor or character --> mode imputation
  else if (is.factor(imputed_df[[col]]) || is.character(imputed_df[[col]])) {
    mode_val <- get_mode(imputed_df[[col]])
    imputed_df[[col]][is.na(imputed_df[[col]])] <- mode_val
    
    # Optional: convert character --> factor (helps with glm)
    if (is.character(imputed_df[[col]])) {
      imputed_df[[col]] <- as.factor(imputed_df[[col]])
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
distmat.logitps = outer(logitps[Z == 1],logitps[Z==0],"-")
distmat.logitps = abs(distmat.logitps)

rownames(distmat.logitps)= rownames(complete_cases_df)[Z == 1]
colnames(distmat.logitps)= rownames(complete_cases_df)[Z == 0]
```

# Implementing Calipers
```{r}
addcaliper=function(dmat,z,logitp,calipersd=.2,penalty=1000){
sd.logitp=sd(logitp)
adif=abs(outer(logitp[z==1],logitp[z==0],"-"))
adif=(adif-(calipersd*sd.logitp))*(adif>(calipersd*sd.logitp))
dmat=dmat+adif*penalty
dmat
}
```


```{r}
distmat_caliper=addcaliper(distmat.logitps,Z,logitps,calipersd = 0.5)
```

# matching
```{r}
library(optmatch)
```

```{r}
noControls = 1
matchvec=pairmatch(distmat.logitps,controls=noControls,data=complete_cases_df)
```

```{r}
summary(matchvec)
```
```{r}
generating_matched_pair_mat <- function(matched_vec, df){
  matchvec.num = as.numeric(substr(matched_vec,start=3,stop=10))
  matchvec.num.notNA = matchvec.num[!is.na(matchvec.num)] #To remove individuals who didn't get matched.
  matchID <- unique(matchvec.num.notNA)
  
  I = length(matchID)
  
  matchedPairMat = matrix(0,I,4)
  colnames(matchedPairMat) = c("SubjectID (Treated)","SubjectID (Control)","PS (Treated)","PS (Control)")
  treatedSubjID = rownames(df)[Z==1]
  controlSubjID = rownames(df)[Z==0]
  
  treatedSubjID = as.integer(treatedSubjID)
  controlSubjID = as.integer(controlSubjID)
  
  for(i in 1:I) {
  subjectIDs = which(matchvec.num == matchID[i])
  matchedPairMat[i,"SubjectID (Treated)"] = subjectIDs[subjectIDs %in% treatedSubjID]
  matchedPairMat[i,"SubjectID (Control)"] = subjectIDs[subjectIDs %in% controlSubjID]
  matchedPairMat[i,"PS (Treated)"] = round(logitps[matchedPairMat[i,"SubjectID (Treated)"]],3)
  matchedPairMat[i,"PS (Control)"] = round(logitps[matchedPairMat[i,"SubjectID (Control)"]],3)
  }
  return(matchedPairMat)
}


df_matched_pairs_no_calip <- generating_matched_pair_mat(matchvec, complete_cases_df)

```

```{r}
matchvec_caliper=pairmatch(distmat_caliper,controls=noControls,data=complete_cases_df)

df_matched_pairs_calip <- generating_matched_pair_mat(matchvec_caliper, complete_cases_df)
```
